title: Diagnostic scan
prompt: Implement `static List<string> CompilerWarnings(string source)`: compile the source as a library and return the IDs (d.Id) of all WARNING-severity diagnostics (no errors expected in the given inputs), deduplicated and sorted. Example input that warns: "public class A { public int X; }" — CS0169 (unused field) only appears when the field is private and never used; public fields do not warn, so use "public class A { int y; }" for the warning case.

tests.name: warnings
tests.hint: GetDiagnostics() returns warnings and errors; filter Severity == Warning; Distinct().OrderBy().ToList().
